Matrix, take, sides
Cc11709, take 1; order number 2-022051 Disputed: sources disagree

Commons and the discography identify take 1. The upstream table says “CC-11709-2” but also gives “CC 11709I”; its own cited reference says take 1. The discography lists take 2 as unpublished.

  • Cc11709, take 1 (Commons and discography; preferred identification)
  • Cc11709, take 2 (upstream table; internally inconsistent)

Processing
Record cleaning machine and ELP laser turntable Documented

The source categories identify Keith Monks Archivist Duo Omni, RCM Mk. IX, and ELP LT-2XA. Detailed restoration, pitch adjustment and equalisation are not documented.

[2]
Composition rights
Traditional melody; Chaliapin–Keneman arrangement is public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms Inferred, not documented

The source gives the arrangers’ deaths as 1938 and 1937. No claim of worldwide clearance is made.

[1] [2]
Recording rights
territorial — European public domain; first published 1928 Documented

Allowed on documented publication before 1963: the former 50-year recording term expired before the 2013 extension. US recording status is not established. Commons’ PD-old-70 composition tag is not treated as a recording licence; the upstream item contains no non-commercial restriction. Upstream worldwide/US expiry assertions are not adopted.
